title: SOUTHCOM Strike on Go-Fast Vessel in Caribbean Kills Four
detail: Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere, under U.S. Southern Command, conducted a lethal kinetic strike on September 19, 2026 against a go-fast vessel on established narco-trafficking routes in the Caribbean, killing four people SOUTHCOM labelled 'narco-terrorists'. SOUTHCOM gave no location, weapon or identities. Secondary tallies put the Operation Southern Spear toll at roughly 234 dead across 78 strikes; monthly totals remain unreconciled between outlets.
